basics.name: Yuga (Yu-Chia) Chang
basics.label: Senior Data & Machine Learning Engineer
basics.summary: Data and machine learning engineer with experience building large-scale data platforms, recommendation systems, and production AI applications. Delivered systems across the semiconductor and music industries, from lakehouse infrastructure to personalized recommendations serving millions of users.

work.name: TSMC
work.summary: Building big data infrastructure and applications for analytics and AI workloads.
highlights: Build a private-cloud big data platform that supports analytics and AI applications across TSMC.
Develop lakehouse data workflows with Trino, Apache Iceberg, dbt, and Airflow.
Engineer streaming pipelines with Apache Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming.
Deploy and operate data applications on Kubernetes.

work.name: KKBOX
work.summary: Built production recommendation and generative AI systems for a large-scale music streaming service.
highlights: Scaled KKBOX's recommendation system to deliver more than 100 million personalized recommendations per day to millions of users.
Combined DSSM neural networks, collaborative filtering, and model distillation with AWS SageMaker and Amazon Personalize.
Improved recommendation quality through feature selection and A/B tests that connected NDCG, MAP, and MRR with CTR, favorites, and shares.

Built an AI Playlist feature with fine-tuned LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and music embeddings derived from metadata and audio features. The feature also addressed cold-start recommendations.

work.name: KKBOX
work.summary: Built and optimized large-scale batch and streaming data systems on AWS and GCP.
highlights: Engineered ETL and CDC pipelines for business analytics, event tracking, and recommendation workloads with Spark, Kafka, and Airflow.
Optimized Spark jobs and SQL through partitioning, shuffle tuning, bucketing, and skew handling.
Built data warehouses, marts, and cubes on AWS Athena, with data quality checks for technical metrics and business rules.
Developed a music app with Flutter and FastAPI that plays original songs and AI-generated piano versions.

work.name: Infortrend Technology, Inc.
work.position: Research Engineer, Machine Learning in Computer Vision
highlights: Researched image synthesis, face recognition, object tracking, and detection with CycleGAN, StyleGAN, YOLOv4, SORT, and optical flow.
Pruned and deployed computer vision models to embedded hardware with TensorRT and OpenVINO.

work.name: Ford Motor Company
work.position: Research Engineer Intern, Machine Learning in Computer Vision
highlights: Built a YOLOv3 and LSTM system for dangerous truck-driver behavior, improving detection accuracy from 78.65% to 95.47%.

publications.name: An Effective Deep Learning Framework for Detecting Misconduct of the Trucker
publications.summary: Deep learning system for detecting dangerous truck-driver behavior from video, with 90% accuracy reported in the paper.
